definitions.maxRadius: IntervalMatrix width -> Rat; finite supremum over all 2^width by 2^width entries, no projection or excluded sectors
definitions.stageCenter: word degree bits -> RealMatrix width; cast each final interval midpoint after complete word only
definitions.stageEta: word degree bits -> Rat; 2^width * maxRadius(intervalWord word degree bits intervalIdentity)

frozen_root: forall {width : Nat} (word : List(Instruction width)) (degree bits : Nat), norm(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (stageCenter word degree bits - realWord word realIdentity)) <= Rat.cast(stageEta word degree bits)
binder_audit: Only TYPING/data width, valid literal word, degree, bits. No entry bound, Valid, contraction or unitarity hypotheses at stage root. General library entry-bound theorem may take entry bounds as its local interface; stage root discharges them by stage_enclosure/midpoint_error.
definition_audit: Literal rational finite supremum and stage-end midpoint. Norm is explicit real Euclidean induced operator norm, not global Matrix entrywise norm. No choice/quotient semantics.
proof_graph_before_Lean: sum over dimension yields squared norm <= size^2 * maxradius^2 * vectornorm^2
